title: Hoshino Ichika — Beyond The Sky〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, are you sure you've recovered from your cold?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course I have! My fever's gone down already, and I even rested for longer than usual just in case. I'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. But don't ever overwork yourself like that again. After all, we're finally in a band together with Shiho now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! I know that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm really so glad that we found out why Shiho had been keeping her distance all this time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? What's this all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm just grateful because you made all this happen.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Coming back to school, saying you wanted to form a band...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well, I was the one to bring it up, yes...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But if you hadn't agreed to it in the first place, we wouldn't even be here talking about being in a band with Shiho at all, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... I didn't do anything...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You absolutely helped!
So thank you from me too, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you for agreeing to start a band together with me!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah... You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's...kind of embarrassing to be thanked so directly.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha!
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, look at that, Ichi! It's Miku!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That music video is the same one I saw on the day I had that dream...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: When you look at Miku in our world here...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It makes that SEKAI place we went to seem even more mysterious, doesn't it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. That place is certainly full of mysteries.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The song Untitled appeared in our smartphones suddenly, and playing or stopping the song allows us to travel to and back from that world freely.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! Then we got to meet Miku and Luka there, and they're even in a band together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And then if we find our true feelings, those feelings may give birth to a song or something...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. Miku did say that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Can you believe we were just having band practice there together with Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I definitely never imagined a high school life like this when I was still in the hospital!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Who would?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Back then, I could only watch Miku and think about how amazing it was that she could sing anything...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But... I feel like things are different now.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Saki?
Why the sudden smirk?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because you were smiling.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? But it's not like I never smile or anything...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes, but it's not about the smile.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You seem to be really happy about something, that's why.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, you may be right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I used to not have anything I wanted to do or work hard for. Days rolled by without much purpose for me...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But now...I want to help Saki do what she wants.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And then maybe one day, even Honami will...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, the signal turned green. Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It must be because of Saki, Miku, and Luka that things are starting to be put into motion.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Is there anything I can do too?
For Saki, Shiho, and Honami...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I can't think of anything right now, except...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'll be giving my all to the band.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Well, that's what I'll be doing too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah.
